name: iJAG (Iowa Jobs for America's Graduates) School Career Class
what_you_do: A class at some Iowa schools. Students do projects with employers, go to career fairs and the Career Development Conference, and get mentors and work-based learning.
who_can_apply: Your school has to offer the class. The program pages do not say which grades can join or how students are picked.
pay_detail: No cost or pay is mentioned on the program pages.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Sign up through your school.
how_to_apply: Check the schools list on ijag.org to see if your school offers iJAG. Questions: (515) 216-3140 or info@ijag.org.
notes: iJAG is not a job or internship by itself. It is a class that connects students to employers. Whether your school has it depends on your district.
